text: manosamphasso kuto nicco bhavissati . phuṭṭho bhikkhave vedeti phuṭṭho ceteti phuṭṭho sañjānāti itthetepi dhammā calā ceva byādhā ca aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino . evaṃ bhikkhave dvayaṃ paṭicca manoviññāṇaṃ sambhotīti . dasamaṃ . channavaggo catuttho . tassuddānaṃ palokasuññā saṅkhittaṃ channo puṇṇo ca bāhiyo ejena ca deva vuttā dvayehi apare devati . _________ #1 ma. yu. ayaṃ pāṭho natthi . [128] chayime bhikkhave phassāyatanā adantā aguttā arakkhitā asaṃvutā dukkhādhivāhā honti . katame cha . cakkhuṃ bhikkhave phassāyatanaṃ
